name: What considerations are important when choosing a finish for lever door handles?

mainEntity.name: What considerations are important when choosing a finish for lever door handles?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selecting a finish for your lever door handles, consider the existing hardware and fixtures in your home to ensure a cohesive look. Popular finishes include brushed nickel, oil-rubbed bronze, polished chrome, and matte black, each offering a distinct aesthetic. Durability and maintenance are also factors; for example, polished finishes may show fingerprints more readily, while brushed or matte options can be more forgiving. Additionally, consider the handle's exposure to moisture or sunlight, as some finishes may be more resistant to tarnishing or fading in certain environments.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a finish that complements existing hardware, consider durability and maintenance, and how it will fare in its environment.
